envelope.reason: comparing the installed 0.6.0 workflow with the design found no role that owns this judgement
envelope.cause: operator asked to compare the installed CDD workflow with the design

payload.title: the whole has no assay
payload.body: The assayer judges one unit against its shard; nothing judges the installed workflow as a whole against the design. When the operator asked for that comparison, the purview guard refused dispatching it to an assayer, since it is no unit. Either whole-system conformance is a concept the design must place, with an owner, or it is the operator's own act.
